title: Factor the expression
text: To factor $$x^2+2x-24$$ we want to find numbers $$a$$ and $$b$$ so that $$ab=-24$$ and $$a+b=2$$.

title: Conditions on factors
text: The sign on the product $$ab=-24$$ tells us that a and $$b$$ have opposite signs. The sign on the sum $$a+b=2$$ tells us that the larger of the two is positive.

title: Finding the factors
text: The factors of $$24$$ are: $$1$$ and $$24$$, $$2$$ and $$12$$, $$3$$ and $$8$$, and $$4$$ and $$6$$. Notice that the factors $$4$$ and $$6$$ differ by $$2$$. Thus the factorization is $$\left(x-4\right) \left(x+6\right)$$ so that the product is $$-24$$ and the sum is $$2$$.
